description: This Java class handles the command for assigning staff to a client. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and is annotated as a Spring service. It processes commands to assign staff to clients by delegating to the 'ClientWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: AssignClientStaffCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the assignment of staff to clients; processes commands and delegates to the service layer.

methods.name: AssignClientStaffCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the client write platform service dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the assign staff command by delegating to the service method.
